compute_3d_box_area: compute the volume of 3D bounding boxes given their xyz coordinates
convert_3d_box_center_to_corners: convert 3D bounding boxes from center-size format to corner coordinates
convert_3d_box_corners_to_center: convert 3D bounding boxes from corner coordinates to center-size format
compute_3d_box_iou: compute the intersection over union of two sets of 3D bounding boxes
compute_generalized_3d_box_iou: compute the generalized intersection over union for two sets of 3D bounding boxes
